job.title: Junior UI/UX Designer
job.description: Pixelcraft Studios is a Bengaluru-based product startup building consumer apps for the Indian market. We are looking for a Junior UI/UX Designer to join our growing design team. You will own end-to-end design for mobile-first features, from early wireframes to polished Figma handoffs. A strong eye for typography, colour systems, and accessibility is essential. Experience with user research and usability testing is a plus.
